evidence: Parsed every file with tomllib in memory (no files written). scoring.toml (sha256 95f70d6e..., byte-identical to frozen template): [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0; [weights] functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2 (positive, sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05 (names only a weighted dimension). Every listed name has its directory: tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional, tests/scored/polish, tests/scored/visual. All five judge.toml: the [judge] block through [scoring] is identical to the template (diff empty), with keys exactly {judge='claude-code', mode='batched', timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md', mcp_servers}; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight. Each declares the playwright MCP server (command playwright-mcp, args --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares the 'verifier' server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER'], and test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after the heredoc + sed placeholder substitution and chmod 755 (test.sh:183-192), before run_suite gates (test.sh:213) and scored (test.sh:224). test.sh, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 bd682592..., 13de2b38..., 03c1426f...); score.py resolves POLICY as Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'scoring.toml' (score.py:10) and sits at tests/tools/. Aggregation: gates all_pass; scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 binary (hro_gate_render), constraints 1 binary (hro_gate_shared) - gates binary; functional 43 binary, weights 0.5-2.5 all positive, sum 58.5; polish 5 binary, sum 12; visual 5 likert points=5, weight 1.2 each, each with 1-5 anchors in its description. IDs unique per file, every description non-empty, criterion keys only {id,name,type,weight,description(,points)}, no stray top-level tables. Prompts resolve: each prompt.md exists, contains exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context}, no other {placeholder}; test.sh substitutes {app_context} into tests/*/*/prompt.md before the suites; every hro_* id referenced in a prompt exists in that dimension's judge.toml. Functional prompt directs the judge to restart_app once in protocol D and forbids shell; no other prompt references restart. No CRLF in any judge.toml or test.sh. Budget nesting for wiring sanity: gates 600+600 < 1500; scored 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100 (max-concurrent-agent 1); 1500+11100 < verifier 13200. Adversarial thinking: a broken app cannot exploit wiring (weights/gates live only in scoring.toml; judge.toml carries no weight/model); a conforming app cannot be failed by wiring since every dimension resolves its prompt and MCP servers exactly as the template does. Cosmetic only: 'binary0' (missing space) in scored/polish/prompt.md:12 and the shared NOT EXERCISED line in four prompts; meaning is unambiguous and does not affect structure. Limits: this is a static/manual application of check-rubric-schema / check-scoring-policy / check-verifier-contract behaviour, not a private checker execution; raw-evidence-index.json states no full configured RewardKit run exists, so actual RewardKit loading of these files is unmeasured, but the wiring is template-identical so that gap belongs to the runtime rows rather than this structural row.
